name: ide-swift
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Swift language features with SourceKit-LSP.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to SourceKit-LSP from a complete Swift toolchain. Leave empty to discover the managed toolchain, PATH or the selected Xcode toolchain.

toolchainPath.title: Swift Toolchain
toolchainPath.description: Optional root of the complete Swift toolchain containing usr/bin/swift and sourcekit-lsp. Keep the server, compiler and SDK at matching versions.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install a Swift toolchain when SourceKit-LSP cannot be found.

backgroundIndexing.title: Background Indexing
backgroundIndexing.description: Control SourceKit-LSP background indexing. Server Default preserves the toolchain and project configuration.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which SourceKit-LSP features the editor uses. Swift run/debug/test code lenses need client commands that are not available here.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete Swift names and argument labels.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show function parameters while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to symbol definitions, types and implementations.

callHierarchy.title: Call Hierarchy
callHierarchy.description: Navigate between functions and their callers.

typeHierarchy.title: Type Hierarchy
typeHierarchy.description: Navigate between base and derived types.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents and selections using the toolchain formatter.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename Swift symbols across a package.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify Swift symbols with semantic information.
